column1: # Which top-level tests/l10n/<Name>.java files are proof tests and which are feature tests that live there
# (tools/l10n/ci_gates.py, feature-text kind). A feature-text pull request may edit a feature test; a proof
# test, a file not listed here and a file whose row says proof stay frozen. Add a row in an ordinary pull
# request: a test that asserts shown English, catalog text or how code calls the catalog is proof; when
# unsure, proof. CI reads this list at the merge base, so a pull request's own edit applies only after it merges.
